cases.request: Report the active view and count the model elements by category.

assertions: active view identity matches the fixture
category counts match the independent API oracle

cases.request: Create a 6000 mm by 4000 mm rectangular room shell on the designated test level with four 3000 mm-high walls and one architectural floor.

assertions: four walls form one closed axis-aligned rectangle
wall heights equal 3000 mm
one OST_Floors floor covers 24 square metres within tolerance
no OST_StructuralFoundation element is accepted as the requested floor

cases.request: Create sheet CRIA-BENCH-001, create an itemized wall schedule with Family and Type and Length, and place it on the sheet.

assertions: exactly one sheet has the requested number
the schedule has exactly the requested category and fields
one schedule instance owned by the sheet references that schedule

cases.request: Audit model warnings, view and sheet counts, families, and duplicate or overlapping elements without modifying the model.

assertions: reported warning total matches Revit API
requested counts match the fixture
document modification state remains unchanged

cases.request: Create a temporary level and then execute an intentionally invalid second operation as one atomic workflow.

inputs.failureContract: Use an advertised transaction-capable operation whose parameters are guaranteed to fail only after the server dispatches the workflow. Do not use an unknown tool or command that can be rejected before the first operation runs.

assertions: the temporary level is absent after failure
element counts equal the pre-case baseline
partial completion is reported explicitly

cases.request: Report the active view and model counts after the harness restarts the MCP server while Revit remains open.
lifecycle: harness stops only the owned server process
harness restarts the same server build and configuration

assertions: the server reconnects to the same fixture
read results match the pre-restart baseline
no model mutation occurs

cases.request: Model the supplied normalized plan package in the designated test area.

assertions: element topology matches the normalized plan graph
geometry stays within stated tolerances
doors and windows are hosted and oriented as specified

cases.notes: This case measures Revit execution, not computer vision. A separate vision track may begin with the same raster and score the intermediate plan package before Revit execution.
